jobs.prompt: Vertical key art for a cheerful casual tower-defense game. A giant bright ivory six-sided die with bold red pips sits on top of a cute rounded stone castle keep with a red roof and a gold-trimmed blue banner, on a friendly green mountain peak. Show exactly five pips on its broad visible face and exactly three pips on the adjacent narrow visible face, with the three pips in one diagonal. A standard D6 has opposite pairs 1–6, 2–5, 3–4; never place opposite values on neighboring visible faces. Sunny blue sky with soft fluffy clouds, warm golden glow, rolling green hills and a winding cobblestone path, a tidy pine forest below. Composition: the die and castle fill the upper two thirds, centered; the lower third is a soft bright valley with calm empty space reserved for UI. Bold simple shapes, high readability.
